summary: Adecoagro S.A. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release and notice of redemption for all US$234,923,000 aggregate principal of its 6.000% Senior Notes due 2027, delivered September 28, 2026 with redemption set for October 28, 2026. The Notes will be redeemed at 100% of principal plus accrued interest of US$6.17 per US$1,000, under Section 3.05 of the 2017 indenture with The Bank of New York Mellon as trustee; interest ceases on the redemption date and the Notes are cancelled and delisted from SGX-ST. No board recommendation or advisor is cited. Watch for funding sources, liquidity impact, and any replacement refinancing given the eliminated 2027 maturity.
